title: A-R-E-A

description.main: Volker Hinz's photographs of the New York nightclub Area, published by Edition Stemmle in 1990.
description.extended:
Volker Hinz's photographs of Area, the New York nightclub, published in Schaffhausen by Edition Stemmle in 1990 with texts by Karl Steinorth and Thomas Buchsteiner.

The catalogue record lists fifteen pages of text and sixty leaves of plates, in German, English and French. The book accompanied a run of Area exhibitions that began in 1990 at Fotoforum Bremen, Fotoforum Frankfurt and the Rencontres d'Arles, then toured Germany in 1991 and 1992.

Hinz (1947-2019) was a German photographer from Hamburg who joined the staff of Stern in 1974. He worked from New York for the magazine, where nightlife was among his subjects, and returned to Hamburg in 1986. He revisited the project in 2015 with the exhibition Area Revisited in Hamburg.

notes: EDITION AMBIGUITY: Getty lists two ISBNs on one record, 3723104142 (book, 978-3-7231-0414-9) and 3723104150 (catalogue, 978-3-7231-0415-6). I used 9783723104156 (the one AbeBooks indexes, paperback; cover image from it). Wikipedia gives 3-7231-0414-2 and 134 pages. Hardcover and paperback listings exist; the shelf copy's binding is not verified. No source states the book's subject outright as the Area club beyond the title and the Area exhibitions list; the lead supplied the identification. Pages 134 from Wikipedia; Getty says [15] p. + 60 leaves of plates. Cover image is small (229x315) and low-res. Color not stated in Getty (AbeBooks German listing says 'farbigen'); description avoids saying color. 'Accompanied' the exhibitions is an inference from dates (1990 book, 1990 shows). Hinz pronouns: Wikipedia uses 'his'.
